name: PDF.co
summary: PDF and document processing: text, JSON and table extraction with OCR, text search, template-based parsing, HTML to PDF, merging and file info.

api_key.description: A PDF.co API key (app.pdf.co dashboard). Sent in the x-api-key header.

notes: Credits: most endpoints charge per processed page (text 21, simple text 4, JSON 28, find 35, info 7, Document Parser 42, HTML to PDF 9, merge 2 per page); job.check costs 2 per call. Each answer carries credits and remainingCredits.
Sync calls must finish within 30 seconds; set async=true for anything longer (up to 3 minutes), then poll job.check with the jobId until status is success, failed or aborted.
Inputs are URLs. Results come back as a temporary output URL (valid for expiration minutes, default 60) unless inline=true where the endpoint supports it.
Over the per-minute request limit answers 429; rely on the HTTP status, not the body's status field.

endpoints.name: Extract text from a PDF
endpoints.summary: Text of a PDF or scanned image, with layout and OCR.

url.description: URL of the source file (a public link or a PDF.co temporary-file URL).

pages.description: 0-based page indices or ranges, e.g. '0, 2-5' or '!0' for the last page; all when omitted.

lang.description: OCR language for scanned input, default eng; two at once as eng+deu.

inline.description: Return the text in the answer instead of a file URL (default false).

lineGrouping.description: Line grouping in table cells: 1 by rows, 2 by columns, 3 join orphaned rows.

unwrap.description: Join wrapped lines inside table cells (with lineGrouping 1).

expiration.description: Minutes the output link lives, default 60.

password.description: Password of the PDF, if it has one.

httpusername.description: HTTP auth user for the source URL.

httppassword.description: HTTP auth password for the source URL.

async.description: Run in the background and return a jobId to poll with job.check (default false).

callback.description: Webhook URL called when an async job ends.

notes: A read over POST. 21 credits per page.
